title: Simple Drawing App 🎨
description:
Simple Drawing App 🎨

Overview

The Simple Drawing App is a lightweight web-based drawing tool built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It allows users to create digital sketches on a canvas with adjustable brush sizes and customizable colors.

Features 🚀

✅ Smooth Drawing Experience – Draw freehand with a responsive canvas.
✅ Brush Size Control – Increase or decrease the brush size with simple buttons.
✅ Color Picker – Choose any color for drawing.
✅ Clear Canvas – Erase everything with a single click.
✅ Minimal & Stylish UI – A clean and intuitive interface for effortless drawing.

How It Works? 🎯

1️⃣ Click and hold the mouse on the canvas to start drawing.
2️⃣ Move the mouse to draw continuous strokes.
3️⃣ Use the + and - buttons to adjust the brush size.
4️⃣ Select a color from the color picker to change the brush color.
5️⃣ Press the X button to clear the canvas instantly.

Technologies Used 🛠

🔹 HTML5 Canvas for rendering drawings.
🔹 CSS3 for styling the layout.
🔹 Vanilla JavaScript for handling user interactions.
shortDescription: A minimal yet functional JavaScript drawing app with brush size and color controls.
